description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database viewer interface, including embedded CSS and JavaScript for frontend functionality.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-fetching from the API.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in tabular form.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates the HTML table from data and appends it to the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
